# ✅ Requirement Checklist

## 1. Functional Requirements
- [ ] Are all core features clearly defined?  
- [ ] Are CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) specified?  
- [ ] Are input/output formats documented?  
- [ ] Are business rules and validations included?  
- [ ] Are error handling scenarios defined?  
- [ ] Are integration points with other systems described?  
- [ ] Are edge cases and boundary conditions covered?  

---

## 2. Non-Functional Requirements
- [ ] Performance expectations (response time, throughput, scalability) defined?  
- [ ] Security requirements (authentication, authorization, encryption) documented?  
- [ ] Compatibility requirements (OS, browsers, devices) listed?  
- [ ] Usability requirements (ease of use, developer experience) included?  
- [ ] Reliability and availability requirements specified?  
- [ ] Backup and recovery requirements defined?  
- [ ] Internationalization and localization needs mentioned?  
- [ ] Rate limiting or throttling rules documented?  

---

## 3. Data Requirements
- [ ] Input data formats and constraints defined?  
- [ ] Output data formats specified?  
- [ ] Data validation rules included?  
- [ ] Data storage and persistence requirements documented?  
- [ ] Data consistency across endpoints ensured?  

---

## 4. Testing & Quality Requirements
- [ ] Testability of requirements confirmed?  
- [ ] Acceptance criteria defined for each requirement?  
- [ ] Regression impact considered?  
- [ ] Performance/load testing requirements included?  
- [ ] Security testing requirements listed?  

---

## 5. Documentation & Communication
- [ ] API documentation aligned with actual behavior?  
- [ ] Requirement traceability matrix prepared?  
- [ ] Stakeholder approvals required?  
- [ ] Change management process defined?  

---

## 6. Risks & Constraints
- [ ] Known risks documented (e.g., resource availability, timelines)?  
- [ ] Mitigation strategies defined?  
- [ ] Technical constraints (tools, frameworks, environments) listed?  
- [ ] Legal/compliance requirements considered?  

---

## 7. Entry & Exit Criteria
- [ ] Entry criteria for requirement analysis defined?  
- [ ] Exit criteria (requirements understood, signed-off) documented?  

---

📌 **Tip:** Use this checklist during requirement analysis sessions. Mark each item as complete once verified, and maintain a traceability matrix to ensure every requirement maps to a test case.
